## What's fixed

- **Karousel no longer lets the music stop at the end of the queue.** Karousel used to look for more music only once, when the last song started. If your server sent nothing back, it tried again only after that song had ended. iOS suspends an app that goes quiet in the background, so the music often stopped before Karousel found anything. Now Karousel keeps looking every 15 seconds while the last song plays. Its songs are lined up and mixed in like any others, so the music doesn't pause at the end of the queue.
- **When the queue runs out, Kultr waits for the search that is already running** instead of starting a new one. At that point it has usually already found something.
- **A slow server can't hold Karousel up.** Karousel waits up to 20 seconds in total for your server's similar songs and artists, then fills in from your library. Before, each request could take up to a minute.
- Karousel songs found for a queue you've since replaced are no longer added to the new one.

The playback log (Settings → About) now also shows each Karousel search and how long it took.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` in SideStore and update from there.

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
